column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/WireCorpusTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 0 automatic, 3 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: ported;note:the renderer moved to tests/snapshots/WireCorpusRender.cpp (format strings verbatim); the old --update path is gxbuild3_golden_tests --update wire_corpus_bootloaders (GX_GOLDEN render_file)

new;note:names "SC's flag-only is_decrypted" (old WireCorpusTests.cpp:22) behind every SC fixture's `state is_decrypted=0 decrypted=0` line of wire_corpus_bootloaders.txt (N4): BootloaderSc derives nothing from its bytes, so an all-zero SC parses with is_decrypted() false, and setting the flag alone makes it true with no byte changed (pinned as today; CB and CD derive the state from their bytes)

new;note:names "CB's 1BL crypt toggling instead of forcing" (old WireCorpusTests.cpp:22 and :223, the cb.crypt_1bl lines of wire_corpus_bootloaders.txt) (N4): BootloaderCb::decrypt and encrypt under the 1BL key are one RC4 toggle that flips `decrypted`; decrypt() of a plaintext CB seals it, encrypt() of the sealed CB restores the input, and encrypt() of a plaintext CB gives the same sealed bytes (pinned as today; SC and CD no-op when already in the requested state)

new;note:explains why the corpus renderer writes kPinnedNonce (0x11..0x20) over an all-zero nonce before every crypt (old WireCorpusTests.cpp:23-25 and :72) (N4): two SC seals over an all-zero nonce draw two nonces and differ, two seals over the pinned nonce are byte-identical and keep it at +0x10
